title: ReflowReviewProposalDraft
description: Zero to two temporary, non-authoritative adjustments for tomorrow, derived only from one day of aggregate review statistics.

suggestions.description: Return an empty array when the supplied statistics do not support a concrete, evidence-backed adjustment. Zero suggestions is a valid and common answer.

title.description: A short Chinese label for the adjustment, at most 40 characters. Must contain no digits, no percent sign, and no internal schema, type, property, or protocol names.

factIds.description: The recorded facts that genuinely support this action. Quantities are rendered by the program from the supplied statistics, so citing a fact must never be accompanied by a number in the text.

action.description: One concrete, single, small action to try tomorrow, at most 120 characters, in Chinese. Must contain no digits, no percent sign, and no internal schema, type, property, or protocol names. Must not invent courses, deadlines, people, or projects, judge the person, or speculate about causes.
